latest.title: Goods flow you can read on a phone
latest.summary: On a phone or a portrait tablet, Supply's goods-flow diagram is now a chain you read top to bottom: your importers, depots, factories and shops in the order the goods travel, with the pipes between them. A depot's shops fold into one card from four up, the sites worth a look sit in a row on top, and shops no pipe reaches share one line at the bottom. Tap a site to follow it: what comes in, what goes out, the pipe carrying a short or stalled product in colour, its problems in words, and one tap to its rows or its site page. With no pipe yet, the box says so and links the wiki's guide to imports.
